newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 9.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 9.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Thursday:

* Indonesian central bank governor Sudradjad Djiwandono said on Wednesday the government would maintain prudent fiscal and monetary policies to keep domestic demand in check and shrugged off market speculation of another widening in the dollar-rupiah intervention band.

* The Dow Jones industrial average ended down 51.18 points at 6,549.48 on Wednesday as investors took profits after two consecutive sessions of record closes as long-term bond interest rates continued to rise.
* The Jakarta Composite Index rose 1.84 points, or 0.28 percent, to close at 662.21 points on Wednesday after it recovered from earlier profit taking through a late burst of buying.
* On Thursday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,362.40/63.80 in early trading against the opening of 2,362.50/63.50.
* Mining firm Alter Abadi as it is scheduled to be listed on Thursday.
* Small-sized Bank Pikko after its debut on Wednesday.
* Bank NISP on reports of a plan to launch a joint venture bank with Oversea-Chinese Banking Corp. Ltd of Singapore in January.
* Steady Safe on reports that a subsidiary had launched a two new ferries plying the busy strait between Java and Sumatra islands.
* Fishing firm Daya Guna Samudera on expected higher demand from its main market Japan following reports of an oil tanker accident in the waters off Japan.
* Astra Internasional after launching new models of its popular Kijang van.
